summary: The stakeholder strongly urges the FCC to maintain the current status of the E-rate program, emphasizing its importance in providing essential broadband connectivity for schools and libraries to foster lifelong learning and digital engagement.

claims.requested_action: keep the E-rate program as it currently exists
claims.argument: The E-rate program provides essential broadband connectivity to schools and libraries at discounted rates, contributing to a common good for nearly 30 years
claims.evidence_quote: Please, please keep funding the e-rate.
